title: Concepts can carry reviewed outside identifiers (for example Wikidata)
description:
Later, after the pilot (Ryan decision 3: yes, as a separate story). As an editor, I want to link a concept to a well-known outside identifier such as Wikidata, reviewed like any accepted fact, so that machines know "this is that thing".

```gherkin
Feature: Outside identifiers on concepts
  Scenario: An accepted outside identifier is published
    Given an accepted concept with a suggested Wikidata identifier
    When an editor accepts the identifier
    Then the concept page's structured data lists it as "same as"

  Scenario: An unreviewed outside identifier is not published
    Given a concept with a suggested Wikidata identifier nobody accepted
    Then the structured data does not mention it
```
